theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (RT : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (RB : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ), RT.Represents T → RB.Represents T.boundary → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∫ x in RB.carrier, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * g x * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]) - (∫ x in RT.carrier, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * g x * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 2]) = ∫ x in RT.carrier, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((fderiv ℝ g x).smulRight ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x))) ∂μHE[m + 2]
